Title:
Polished Rocks Minerals Crystals Fossil Shark Teeth Collection Lot
Condition:
Used
Condition Description:
Bundle in used condition, cleaned and handled
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Dimension:
10 x 10 x 10 in
Description:
This collector's bundle features an intriguing mix of loose polished rocks, various mineral specimens, crystal clusters, and fossil fragments, providing broad appeal for geology enthusiasts and educators. Among the assortment are a striking triangular purple crystal cluster resembling amethyst, a large cream-colored crystal matrix, a long translucent white mineral specimen with fibrous striations, and a clear pointed crystal. Other notable pieces include a lustrous golden-brown banded stone, a turquoise-green mineral set on a beige matrix, a rough smaller purple cluster, and a polished gray-lavender slab with mustard veining and open cavities. Fossil interest is added by several dark triangular fragments likely fossil shark teeth, and a selection of multicolored tumbled stones in a small clear bag. All pieces are loose and suited for educational display, personal mineral collections, or hands-on learning. Surfaces range from polished and glossy to granular and rough, with no visible damage or major flaws. The bundle shows standard signs of handling and prior cleaning. An excellent introduction to the hobby of rock and mineral collecting.
